profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: SWE @ Google working on ML Infra and tooling for Google Photos. I have a passion for story telling and photography. Find me in the darkroom!

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.locationName: Los Angeles County, California, United States
positions.description:
Google Photos Model Lifecycle

- Responsible for improving infrastructure and ML training/eval tools for Photos
- Collaborated cross-functionally to collect and serve data for ML training/eval
- Implemented storage solutions for Photos GenAi data
- Piloted synthetic data generation and use cases for Photos

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Working on NASA funded projects for the Chandra X-Ray Center and the Harvard-Smithsonian Astrophysical Observatory. 
• Focusing on immersive virtual reality applications.
• Implemented a data mapping function that maps each element in a supernova to a particular instrument.

company.name: Brown University Center for Computation and Visualization

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Remote Software Engineering intern on the AlphaTrack team.
• Implemented an extensible keyframing system in C++ (within
AlphaTrack’s Extended Kalman Filter Implementation).
• Introduced a 5x increase in estimated position accuracy from
new keyframing strategies.

positions.title: Head Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Organized and co-lead the design and creation of a more
inclusive introduction computer science class.
• Hired and lead an 8 person teaching assistant staff for a class
size of 30.
• Led weekly grading sessions and staff meetings.
• Restructured course to best accommodate students as the
university switched to an online only structure.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Held office hours and lab sections for a class of 160+.
• Lead informational project sessions to prepare students for upcoming assignments.

positions.title: Disk Jockey
positions.description:
• Responsible for generating content for the radio through mixes, playlists, and interviews.
• Leading the creation and implementation of the Index, a public database of all Providence artists.

positions.title: Engineering Practicum Intern
positions.description:
• Engineering Practicum intern working on the Assistant Smart Home team.
• Implemented end to end support in C++ for "explorative" queries that allow users to learn more about their devices.

organizations.name: Mosaic+
organizations.description: Organize Mosaic+, lead industry communication, e-board responsibilities, and department communication.

organizations.name: Mosaic+
organizations.description: Build a running database of resources and tools for academic success for the organization, and organize group study sessions to promote collaborative learning in Computer Science and STEM courses.
